title: Quentin and the Confession
author: Marguerite Sterling
blurb: Dominic Sandoval, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
